thread:
rafael: Hi folks, planning a midyear dependent removal. Ex-partner moved out and custody ended. Need to remove from benefits. What's the required proof and timing? Also payroll refund for overpaid premiums?

sara (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, @rafael. For dependent removal due to custody change, we need a copy of the custody order or court documents showing the end of custody, or a notarized declaration if court docs aren't available. Use "Dependent Removal" in the portal and upload docs. Removal is effective on the date specified in the court order or the date of the custody change. We will stop premiums after the effective date; if premiums were paid for past coverage, payroll will process a retro refund or adjustment on the next payroll cycle. If you need the refund earlier, let us know and we'll prioritize payroll's ticket.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: dependent removals must include supporting documentation. Exceptions handled case-by-case. See: https://benefits.redwood.com/dependent-removal-policy :information_source:

rafael: Thanks — uploading the custody decree now. Appreciate the help.
